title: ANNCSU address index
description:
The streets and access points of ANNCSU in two Parquet files sorted by comune. A client reads the rows of one comune with HTTP range requests and no server, and looks up first the street, then the house number. The format is described by a [draft STAC extension](https://github.com/anncsu-open/anncsu-viewer/blob/main/geocoding/address-index/v0.1.0/README.md) kept in this repository.

The `codice_istat` column holds the `feature_id` of the `gazetteer` collection: the gazetteer finds the comune, this index finds the address. An application that always works inside a single comune can use this index alone, with the comune's code. The data comes from the ANNCSU release of 2 November 2026.

streets.title: Streets
streets.description: One row per street and one per name it has in another language, sorted by `codice_istat`, `name_norm` and `street_id`.

table:columns.name: codice_istat
table:columns.description: Istat code of the comune, six digits as text: the feature_id of the gazetteer. First sort column.

table:columns.name: comune
table:columns.description: Name of the comune from the Istat list, to display a result without reading the gazetteer.

table:columns.name: street_id
table:columns.description: Stable identifier of the street, the PROGRESSIVO_NAZIONALE of ANNCSU.

table:columns.name: name
table:columns.description: The street name to display: the ODONIMO as published, or the name in another language on an alternate row.

table:columns.name: name_norm
table:columns.description: The name normalized by anncsu-odonimo/1: NFD decomposition, diacritics removed, lowercase, every character other than letters, digits, spaces and hyphens replaced by a space, repeated spaces collapsed. So LIBERTA' and libertà both give liberta.

table:columns.name: name_lang
table:columns.description: ISO 639-3 language of the name on rows in another language, when it is known. Null on the main row.

table:columns.name: alt_of
table:columns.description: Null on the main row. On a row in another language, the street_id of the street.

table:columns.name: numbers
table:columns.description: Number of access points on the street.

table:columns.name: number_min
table:columns.description: The lowest house number on the street. Null if no access point has a number.

table:columns.name: number_max
table:columns.description: The highest house number on the street. With number_min it tells apart streets with the same name.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct(xmin double, ymin double, xmax double, ymax double)
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the street's access points in WGS84 degrees, leaving out those outside the comune boundary; if all of them are, it covers all of them.

access-points.title: Access points
access-points.description: One row per access point of the source, sorted by `codice_istat`, `street_id`, `number`, `suffix`, `specificita` and `id`, nulls last.

table:columns.name: codice_istat
table:columns.description: Istat code of the comune, six digits as text: the feature_id of the gazetteer. First sort column.

table:columns.name: street_id
table:columns.description: The street of the access point: the street_id of the streets file, the PROGRESSIVO_NAZIONALE of ANNCSU.

table:columns.name: id
table:columns.description: Stable identifier of the access point, the PROGRESSIVO_ACCESSO of ANNCSU.

table:columns.name: number
table:columns.description: The house number, the CIVICO of ANNCSU. Null where the source has none.

table:columns.name: suffix
table:columns.description: The ESPONENTE of ANNCSU, the letter part of the house number: A, B, BIS, 1.

table:columns.name: specificita
table:columns.description: The SPECIFICITA of ANNCSU, which holds among other things the red and black numbering of Genova, Firenze and Savona.

table:columns.name: metrico
table:columns.description: The METRICO of ANNCSU: the house number in metres, in comuni that use metric numbering. Text, as in the source.

table:columns.name: out_of_bounds
table:columns.description: True when the access point falls more than 110 metres outside the boundary of its comune, according to Istat boundaries. Null when the comune has no matching boundary.

table:columns.name: lon
table:columns.description: Longitude of the access point in degrees, WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

table:columns.name: lat
table:columns.description: Latitude of the access point in degrees, WGS84 (EPSG:4326).
